groups.stand: Standouts: the six that look best together

mats.name: Gilded Peacock
mats.why: Art deco on art deco: gold fan lines and peacock feathers on deep teal, with an ivory center like her faces.

mats.name: Deco Dragon (Mulberry)
mats.why: Bam Bird Boutique's own Deco Dragon mat, in her sister color. Same deco lines and dragons as the tiles, and the mulberry plays off the teal instead of copying it.

mats.name: Crane Cloud
mats.why: White cranes circling a gold sun on deep teal, inside a lagoon-blue cloud border. Her teal backs and gold palms, and a crane like her 1 Bam.
mats.added_after_review: Nov 8 6:24pm: Tiffany brought it in (Silk Mahjong, no affiliate program; whole line allowed 6:25pm). Leatherette or neoprene, same listing.

mats.name: Deco Dragon (Indigo)
mats.why: Bam Bird Boutique's navy Deco Dragon. It matches her navy dots and numbers, and the dragons match hers.

mats.name: Bamboo Dragon
mats.why: Your add from the catalog search (round 2).

mats.name: White Lotus
mats.why: Shown twice in Tiles & Tablescapes with Deco Lagoon: soft aqua and ivory with a gold key frame. Her gold palm and ivory faces, with a lighter teal around her.

mats.name: East Meets West – Magenta

mats.name: Gatsby's Feathered Affair

mats.name: Sapphire Blooms
mats.why: A teal scallop center, the same fan-shell deco as her backs, framed in mulberry and gold inside a navy garden of plum, berry and teal peonies. Her two colours plus gold, in one mat.

Reba stays the first non-TNT card; Deco Dragon (Mulberry) #8 (sister mat never #1).
_order_nov08: Re-ordered Nov 8 by the Playbook step 7 rule (Tiffany 1:46pm): standouts first (the 5-6 that look best together), colour theory carries the weight, her pairings + TNT recs add a little; TNT recs get no automatic front spot (label kept as information); the sister mat may be #1 if it is truly best.
